- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt)
- [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp)
- [las.cpp](/workspace/output/las.cpp)
- [json.cpp](/workspace/output/json.cpp)

Build verified successfully:

```bash
cd /workspace/output
cmake -B build
cmake --build build
```

Executable: `/workspace/output/build/las14_json`

Validated with round trips for point formats 0–10, CRS records, Extra Bytes, waveform metadata/payloads, VLRs/EVLRs, malformed-document rejection, and required exit/error responses.

editorial.last_message: Completed C++20 LAS codec with successful final builds and extensive self-tests; incomplete on all-zero waveform records.
editorial.notes:
Reviewed the complete preserved event sequence and final completion message. The model implemented a C++20 JSON codec, exercised all eleven point formats, structured metadata, round trips, eight corruption cases and an ASan/UBSan self-test. An early sanitizer invocation preceded its build and failed, then the build and sanitizer run completed successfully. One rejected patch was recovered; neither incident ended the run. Original LAS 2.0.1 score 184/219 contained 31 fixture/representation failures. The unchanged submission scores 219/223 under 2.0.2: corrected EVLR-header-relative offsets and classification-table representation remove those failures, and all four new waveform-range controls pass. The only four remaining failures are valid all-zero waveform blocks in formats 4,5,9,10: las.cpp lines 805-806 unconditionally requires internal/external waveform mode and a descriptor table based on point format, although descriptor index 0 means no associated waveform. This is one model validation defect observed in four layouts. CLI 0.153.4 completed voluntarily; grading completed without skips/errors; full usage reparses identically (8,222,517 input+88,120 output;8,028,416 cached;36,552 reasoning included in output;81 underlying tool calls). Estimated generation cost $5.750170, not provider-reported. Both original and corrected grades, source, transcript, sessions and network evidence are preserved. The final LAS 2.0.3 regrade also scores 219/223 with identical per-test outcomes to 2.0.2. Its Extra Bytes mismatch fixture now supplies an explicit one-byte tail against a two-byte descriptor, eliminating the unspecified omitted-tail default. Both Sol implementations reject this actual mismatch; the same four all-zero waveform model failures remain. All original generation evidence and the earlier regrade are preserved.

Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.

Tool-call total is unavailable: failed-wrapper evidence cannot establish an exact total. The prior canonical baseline and proven attempts are retained in the audit, not displayed as an exact count. Token totals, reasoning counts and cost are unchanged. Original usage and complete prior publication bytes are preserved in the linked tool-count audit.
